title: VC & startup CRM with AI chatbot
summary: Lead generation, deal tracking, Chrome plug-ins and a WhatsApp chatbot for a venture capital partner.
problem: A venture capital partner needed tools to source startups, manage leads and track deals efficiently at scale.
solution: Built a CRM and automation platform with lead generation, monitoring and custom Chrome plug-ins, plus a WhatsApp chatbot and client management system for deal flow.
result: Improved deal-sourcing efficiency by 35%, sped up decision-making and improved client engagement.
